draft_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
revised_text: Thornbill-NER is robust to label noise: its F1 drop stayed within the pre-specified criterion at 10%, 20% and 30% noise (0.6, 1.3 and 1.8 points).
rationale: T2.r1-r3.th_drop give 0.6, 1.3, 1.8 points, all ≤ 2.0, matching the pre-specified criterion. The claim is scoped to the evaluated noise rates and the drop values are exact.
